mapper.sql: c.diagram_id, c.user_id, d.title, d.diagram_type, c.current_xml, c.summary, c.analysis_json, c.version, c.created_at, GREATEST(c.updated_at, d.updated_at) AS updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM diagram_canvas_state c INNER JOIN diagram d ON d.id = c.diagram_id AND d.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.diagram_id = #{diagramId} AND d.deleted = 0

SELECT d.id AS diagram_id, d.user_id, d.title, d.diagram_type, NULL AS current_xml, c.summary, c.analysis_json, c.version AS version, d.created_at, GREATEST(c.updated_at, d.updated_at) AS updated_at FROM diagram d INNER JOIN diagram_canvas_state c ON c.diagram_id = d.id AND c.user_id = d.user_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT FROM diagram d INNER JOIN diagram_canvas_state c ON c.diagram_id = d.id AND c.user_id = d.user_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY GREATEST(c.updated_at, d.updated_at) ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagram (id, user_id, diagram_type) VALUES (#{diagramId}, #{userId}, COALESCE(#{diagramType}, 'basic')) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE diagram_type = COALESCE(VALUES(diagram_type), diagram_type), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT IGNORE INTO diagram_canvas_state (diagram_id, user_id, current_xml, summary, analysis_json, version) VALUES (#{diagramId}, #{userId}, #{currentXml}, #{summary}, #{analysisJson}, COALESCE(#{version}, 0) + 1)

INSERT INTO diagram (id, user_id, title, diagram_type, thumbnail_url, deleted) SELECT #{targetDiagramId}, #{targetUserId}, d.title, d.diagram_type, d.thumbnail_url, 0 FROM diagram d WHERE d.id = #{sourceDiagramId} AND d.user_id = #{sourceUserId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM diagram existing WHERE existing.id = #{targetDiagramId} )

INSERT INTO diagram_canvas_state (diagram_id, user_id, current_xml, summary, analysis_json, version) SELECT #{targetDiagramId}, #{targetUserId}, c.current_xml, c.summary, c.analysis_json, c.version FROM diagram_canvas_state c INNER JOIN diagram d ON d.id = c.diagram_id AND d.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.diagram_id = #{sourceDiagramId} AND c.user_id = #{sourceUserId} AND d.deleted = 0

INSERT INTO diagram_conversation_message (diagram_id, user_id, session_id, client_message_id, role, content, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{targetDiagramId}, #{targetUserId}, m.session_id, m.client_message_id, m.role, m.content, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM diagram_conversation_message m INNER JOIN diagram d ON d.id = m.diagram_id AND d.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.diagram_id = #{sourceDiagramId} AND m.user_id = #{sourceUserId} AND d.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE diagram_canvas_state SET user_id = #{anonymizedUserId}, current_xml = '', summary = NULL, analysis_json = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE diagram SET user_id = #{anonymizedUserId}, title = 'Deleted diagram', thumbnail_url = NULL, deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
